jobs.jd: The Central Science Team within Amazon’s People Experience and Technology org (PXTCS) uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, well-being, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team, which combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build production machine learning solutions that improve employee experiences and inform workforce decisions. You will work on problems spanning predictive modeling, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, generative AI, and causal evaluation. These solutions will predict workforce outcomes, identify individual and organizational needs, recommend targeted actions, and measure the causal impact of programs, products, and policies across diverse employee populations and business contexts. As an Applied Scientist, you will develop models and algorithms from prototype through production. You will collaborate with other scientists and economists to combine machine learning with causal inference and experimentation, allowing teams to understand both what is likely to happen and which actions will improve outcomes. You will also work with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate methods and results to technical and nontechnical audiences. jobs.jd: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. What You’ll Bring: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs. Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected. GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization. Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling. Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking. Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion). Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
jobs.jd:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems 

 

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in distributed systems and ML infrastructure for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • You are proficient in Python and in at least one systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go) ● You have experience operating large-scale training or serving infrastructure, or schedulers and orchestration systems for GPU or other high-performance workloads
  • You understand what limits throughput/latency in distributed inference workloads: communication, memory, scheduling, and stragglers
  • You have strong debugging, profiling, and incident-diagnosis skills, ideally including on-call experience 
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Prior experience training machine learning models is valuable but not essential for engineers with strong distributed systems or HPC backgrounds 

 

Bonus Points (any of the following): 

  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, including batching and KV-cache management 
  • You have experience with RL training systems and rollout infrastructure 
  • You have experience with collective communication (NCCL), RDMA, or low-latency networking 
  • You have experience with GPU benchmarking, profiling, and cluster performance monitoring 
  • You have experience building sandboxed code execution or large-scale evaluation infrastructure 
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or distributed systems projects 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Competitive global benefits
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Opportunity to collaborate closely with colleagues across the Datadog offices in New York City and Paris 
  • Opportunity to attend and present at conferences and meetups
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

 

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Singapore
jobs.jd: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s computer vision AI open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We’re curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You’ll Do We’re hiring Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to be the first technical hands on our new customer’s Roboflow deployments. After our Sales and Solutions Architecture team closes a deal and validates the technical approach, you step in to take it from proof-of-concept to production, the critical 0-to-1 phase where vision meets reality. You’ll embed directly with new Customers, working alongside their engineering and operations teams to build and deploy their first production computer vision workflows on Roboflow. This is the most difficult, important and rewarding phase of the customer journey. Infrastructure is unfamiliar, data pipelines need to be built, edge devices need to be configured, and models need to perform in real-world conditions, not just in a demo or a lab. The FDE role is more than just execution, you are also our eyes and ears in the field. You'll see the gap between what a Customer thinks they want, and what they actually need. That insight is invaluable, and you'll feed it directly back to our Product and Engineering teams, shaping the Roboflow platform and solution offerings. The best FDEs don't just deploy solutions; they surface the problems worth solving next. Once you’ve proven the deployment works in production and the customer’s team is equipped to operate it, you hand off to our Implementation Engineers who scale, optimize, and expand the solution across additional use cases. You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder. Five years from now, FDE at Roboflow on a resume should mean what a few years at Palantir or a FAANG company means. That's the bar we're hiring against. Role and Responsibilities 0-to-1 Deployment: Take validated proof-of-concepts from the pre-sales process and build the first production deployment. This includes data pipeline setup, model optimization, edge device configuration, and integration with customer infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
jobs.jd:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points (any of the following):

  • You have experience with Mixture-of-Experts models, expert parallelism, or sparse model inference
  • You are familiar with GPU communication libraries such as NCCL or NVSHMEM, and with compute/communication overlap
  • You have experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or similar kernel frameworks
  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have built GPU-intensive systems in graphics, rendering, simulation, or scientific computing
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or systems infrastructure projects

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Ads Brand Safety and Suitability
jobs.jd: Amazon Ads Brand Safety & Suitability protects advertisers from exposure to unsafe, unsuitable, or policy-violating content across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio advertising inventory. Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity. AI is fundamentally changing the content landscape. Content is now generated at unprecedented scale, faster, cheaper, and increasingly sophisticated. Low-quality, deceptive, AI-generated, and synthetic content evolves in real time, constantly adapting to evade detection. The volume and velocity of new content entering the advertising system has outpaced traditional classification approaches. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to work on the next generation of AI-powered Brand Safety and Content Classification systems designed to protect advertisers and elevate supply quality at internet scale. This is not a traditional classification problem. You will build systems that make millisecond-level decisions across billions of content signals while continuously adapting to emerging content risks driven by generative AI. You will own the science strategy for LLM-powered classification and semantic understanding, real-time multimodal content evaluation, adversarial ML and adaptive model resilience, proactive risk intelligence and content risk hunting, AI-generated and synthetic content detection, and large-scale abusive content system identification and disruption. You will define how modern AI separates high-quality advertising inventory from unsafe, unsuitable, and policy-violating content, across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio surfaces. What Makes This Role Unique Generative AI has dramatically lowered the cost of producing deceptive, policy-evasive content, and the adversary evolves daily. Your detection systems must reason contextually, adapt rapidly, and generalize beyond previously seen content risk patterns. Static models fail here; you will build living systems that learn and respond in real time. You will do this at internet scale, developing low-latency ML and LLM-powered systems evaluating content safety, brand suitability, misinformation risk, and emerging content risk vectors across massive real-time traffic streams, making billions of decisions per day with single-digit millisecond latency constraints. This role sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and large-scale production engineering, combining deep science, system-wide impact, and business-critical outcomes. The models your team ships directly influence billions of dollars in advertising spend and the trust of the world's largest brands in Amazon DSP. The Science Problems Are Genuinely Hard You will tackle challenges including detecting sophisticated AI-generated and synthetic content, understanding nuanced contextual brand risk, identifying coordinated MFA space before they scale, balancing precision, recall, latency, explainability, and fairness, designing adaptive models resilient to adversarial evolution, and leveraging LLMs for semantic understanding in real-time, latency-constrained environments. Why This Matters Few roles offer the opportunity to work at the intersection of frontier AI, internet-scale production systems, adversarial environments, and business-critical impact, while tackling open-ended scientific challenges with real-world societal relevance. As AI reshapes the internet, the systems your team builds will define what trustworthy, high-quality digital systems look like for the next decade. About the Role: We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for VC and adjacent tasks (controllable TTS, voice design and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems. You will thrive in this role if you: See research and engineering as two sides of the same coin and enjoy owning work end-to-end. Are results-oriented, flexible, and willing to pick up whatever moves the needle. Like collaborating closely with infra, data, and product to ship measurable improvements. Enjoy designing experiments, listening tests, and metrics that correlate with user-perceived quality. Eager to learn every-day, find and solve unique large-scale problems. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Prime Video - Ads Science
jobs.jd: Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you! Key job responsibilities The science challenges include: - Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time. - Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals. - Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles. - Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies. - Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. jobs.title: Applied Scientist III - Amazon Identity Program, Amazon Identity Program (AIP)

Amazon Advertising is looking for an Applied Scientist III to help solve it at global scale, applying advanced AI, graph neural networks, and probabilistic modeling to connect billions of identity signals across devices, publishers, and the open internet. The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers how advertisers recognize, reach, and measure audiences across the advertising ecosystem. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans an increasing number of devices and environments, we are investing in new scientific approaches to build a more accurate, scalable, and privacy conscious identity graph. As a senior scientific leader, you will develop novel approaches to probabilistic identity resolution, graph neural networks (GNNs), representation learning, and large scale entity matching. You will combine deterministic identity signals from Amazon's owned and operated properties with signals from publishers, agencies, and third party identity providers to build accurate identity models across increasingly fragmented digital environments. You will define scientific direction, design and evaluate new models, and partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring research into production. Your work will directly influence advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and billions of dollars in advertising revenue. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in applied machine learning, graph algorithms, and probabilistic modeling, with a demonstrated ability to translate scientific research into production systems. jobs.jd:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

jobs.title: Physical Design Engineer - Static Timing Analysis, Annapurna Labs, Cloud Scale Machine Learning
jobs.jd: AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team you’ll be responsible for the design and optimization of Hardware in our data centers including technologies such as AWS Inferentia which is a machine learning inference product designed to deliver high performance at low cost. You’ll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with thought-leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve our products' performance, quality and cost. We’re changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today. Key job responsibilities • Develop & maintain flows for block and full-chip level static timing analysis • Write, debug & validate timing constraints for blocks and full-chip. • Run Static Timing Analysis and give frequent feedback to team members and leads. • Provide guidance on how to fix timing issues (generate ECOs, fix constraint issues). • Develop scripts to automate running timing analysis and generate reports. • Be a highly-valued member of our start-up like team through excellent collaboration and teamwork with other physical design engineers as well as with the RTL/Arch. teams - Experience scripting or coding - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent - Expertise in timing analysis fundamentals - 1+ years doing Static Timing Analysis - 1+ years with timing constraint development - Timing Analysis using EDA tools (examples: PrimeTime, Tempus, or others) - Understanding of ASIC Physical Design from RTL-to-GDSII - Understanding of other sign-off activities (ir/em, physical verification, DFT) - 1+ years of scripting experience with Tcl, Perl or Python - Experience in ECO flows (examples: PT-DMSA, Tempus-ECO, Tweaker or others) - Experience in advanced nodes - 16nm or below - Expertise in parasitic extraction tools (examples: STAR-RC, Quantus or others) - Expertise on circuit level analysis using tools like SPICE / SPECTRE - Experience with timing of IO interfaces like DDR, HBM, PCIe, Die-to-Die etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek
jobs.jd: Je bent recent afgestudeerd van een bèta / kwantitatieve opleiding, bent statistisch goed onderlegd en je hebt ook al enige ervaring opgedaan met R, SPSS en/of Python en op zoek naar een mogelijkheid om je eerste stappen in de wereld van Data te zetten. Wij hebben dan een erg gave uitdaging in de aanbieding waarin je je kunt ontwikkelen binnen een publieke omgeving waarin je met onderzoek data het verschil kunt maken binnen maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Als Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek werk je binnen een team wat zich richt op beleidsonderzoek en informatie binnen de verschillende domeinen van een lokale overheidsinstelling. Dit team verzamelt statistische informatie over het stedelijk gebied en voert uiteenlopende onderzoeken uit: van snelle opiniepeilingen tot diepgaande data-analyses en dashboards. Jij speelt hierbij een centrale rol: je beheert databanken, ontwikkelt dashboards, ondersteunt grootschalige enquêtes, en zorgt dat data toegankelijk én begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt voor collega’s en beleidsmakers. Je werkt met tools als R, SPSS, Python en Tableau, en krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise in data, visualisatie en statistiek volop te ontwikkelen. Wat kun je verwachten? Met deze opdracht binnen het Data & Analytics traineeship geef jij jouw carrière een vliegende start! In twee jaar tijd behaal je waardevolle certificaten, volg je boeiende trainingen op ons gezellige kantoor in Bunnik, én werk je aan uitdagende projecten bij één van onze opdrachtgevers. Tijdens het eerste jaar ligt de focus op jouw ontwikkeling als professional én als persoon. In de eerste twee weken duik je met andere trainees ons kantoor in, waar je trainingen volgt in zowel soft als hard skills. Daarna ga je aan de slag bij je opdrachtgever. In het tweede jaar werk je samen met ons aan een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan dat helemaal is afgestemd op jouw ambities. Wat bieden wij jou? Je kunt goed schakelen tussen data en praktijk: je vertaalt cijfers naar bruikbare inzichten. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Detail Page
jobs.jd: Amazon.com’s Product Detail Page team is looking for talented, motivated and passionate applied scientist to be part of the design and development of a highly scalable multi-tiered shopping application to provide the best possible online shopping experience for Amazon customers world-wide. Our team is comprised of talented applied scientists, developers, testers, program managers, designers and product managers tasked with the singular goal to create THE world's best buying experience. Scientists on this team develop the next-generation technologies and experiences that change how millions interact and shop online. To provide the best possible online shopping at the scale of the web requires ideas from every area of computer science, including distributed computing, large-scale system design, machine learning, natural language processing, data compression and user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. We need our scientists to be versatile and always eager to tackle new problems as we continue to push technology forward. Our team leverages sophisticated econometric, machine learning, and big data technologies to help customers to discover the right products at the right prices from millions of trusted sellers billions of times a day. If you are looking for a career-defining opportunity on one of the most customer centric and business impacting teams within Amazon, we’d love to hear from you. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to help build the next generation of Detail Page optimization algorithms. These new set of algorithms will incorporate the continually changing preferences of our customers and continue to scale with numerous new programs that Amazon is introducing for our customers. You will work with multiple Amazon businesses and programs to identify big business opportunities and propose new business features and technical systems to improve customer experience on Amazon Detail Page, Search Page and many other widgets throughout the website. You will be responsible for the quality of algorithm design and will get the opportunity to present your ideas and share results of your deliverables with Amazon executives on a frequent basis. You will get an opportunity to work with senior scientists to define and enforce broad, company-wide technical standards in optimization techniques, statistical modeling and simulation techniques, and/or data analytics. - 3+ years of building models for business application experience - PhD, or Master's degree - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing - Experience using Unix/Linux - Experience in professional software development Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.jd: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work. Requirements • You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery • You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software. • Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job. Key job responsibilities • Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption • Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision • Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team • Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices • Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.jd: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work. Requirements • You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery • You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software. • Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job. Key job responsibilities • Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption • Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision • Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team • Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices • Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, TTS
jobs.jd: About Cantina Cantina is a new social platform founded by Sean Parker with the most advanced AI character creator. Our bots are lifelike, social creatures that can interact wherever people are online—across voice, video, and text. Create yourself, imagine someone new, or choose from thousands of characters to share infinitely scalable, personalized content and seamless group chat. If you’re excited about how AI can shape creativity and social interaction, come help us build what’s next. About the Role: We’re looking for a Research / ML Engineer to join our Speech Team to build state-of-the-art speech systems end-to-end—from data specs through production inference. You’ll drive the model ↔ data ↔ eval flywheel for TTS and adjacent tasks (voice cloning, controllable TTS, voice conversion and more), partnering closely with research, data, and infra to ship fast, reliable, and cost-aware models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems. What You’ll Do: Model Building: Architect, implement, pre-train, fine-tune, and post-train/alignment (e.g., GRPO/DPO) for large-scale speech models. Project Leadership: Independently lead small research projects while collaborating on larger team initiatives. Experimental Design: Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of the models. Tool Development: Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity. Full-Stack Contribution: Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design. Data Ownership: Define data requirements and collaborate on acquisition, curation, augmentation, labeling quality, and synthetic data strategies. Rigorous Evaluation: Design automated objective/subjective evaluations—listening tests, SV/WER/ASR-based metrics, robustness & bias checks, and red-team studies. Pipeline Delivery: Harden the training → evaluation → inference pipeline; profile latency, memory, and cost; and meet production SLAs with robust monitoring and rollback. GPU Scaling: Partner with infrastructure to run distributed training/inference on cloud fleets and productionize models with reliability and observability. Safety & Responsibility: Contribute to safety/consent guardrails and to misuse/abuse mitigation for responsible speech technology. What You’ll Bring: Exceptional research/development experience with large scale audio models (>3B models and >500k hours data). Exceptional understanding and hands-on experience with transformer architectures and/or diffusion models (inc. distillation and streaming) and/or audio language modelling. Strong experience with multi-node and multi-gpu distributed model training. Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems Strong with PyTorch and performance work (profiling, CUDA/Triton/C++ as needed) and writing reliable production quality code. Shipped large scale speech/audio models to production. Background in working with large-scale ML data. Ability to iterate on data,, and triangulate quality using subjective and objective signals. Notable publications and/or open source contributions in speech/audio/ML. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Preferred Experience: Shipped large scale speech/audio models (TTS/VC/ASR) to production. Work on large-scale ML systems. Experience with audio language modelling, transformer architectures. Experience with voice-cloning, speech-control, voice-generation. Background in processing large-scale ML data. Publications or notable open-source in speech/audio/ML. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
jobs.jd: About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer’s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative [Germany]
jobs.jd: You'll be Luma's creative lead on the ground with major brands and agencies, turning what our models can do into production workflows they actually use. Sitting between the technology and the craft, you'll shape how top creators work with generative video, and produce high-craft work in Luma yourself as the proof. These are foundational Forward Deployed Creative roles in the region, so you'll be defining how partner engagement works here rather than following a set playbook. It fits a senior creative who's comfortable shaping the approach as they go and consulting directly with senior partners. If you'd rather execute an established process, this isn't the fit. What You'll Own Partner directly with leading brands and creative agencies as their creative and strategic guide to generative AI. Architect and prototype AI-accelerated production workflows that help partners move faster and raise their storytelling. Create hands-on, high-craft content in Luma that sets the bar and becomes inspirational case studies. Consult with partner leadership, translating technical capability into concrete creative and business opportunities. Work as an on-the-ground extension of Product, Partnership, and Sales, bringing real-world insight back into the roadmap. Set the tone and the playbook for how the Forward Deployed Creative function engages partners in the region. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn Luma and the models deeply, meet priority partners, and understand their pipelines and where generative AI helps most. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build a real AI-accelerated workflow with a partner and produce a high-craft case study from it. Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Turn what works into repeatable boards and playbooks other FDCs and partners can use. What You Bring Senior client-facing creative experience (Creative Director, Creative Technologist, Technical Director, or similar) at a top agency, studio, or tech company. An outstanding portfolio of shipped, high-craft work showing taste, technical skill, and storytelling. A portfolio is required. Deep expertise in creative production pipelines (VFX, animation, motion graphics, or production) and designing new workflows using generative AI A track record of building new things in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Exceptional communication and presentation, able to act as a strategic consultant to senior creative and business leaders. Genuine enthusiasm for the creative potential of AI. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with generative AI creative tools (Luma, Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion). A public profile as a creator or thought leader in emerging tech or generative art. Experience at an innovative agency (e.g. Buck, The Mill) or an in-house tech/brand lab (e.g. Google Creative Lab, Apple Marcom). About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: ** This role can be hired in either Zurich or Lausanne ** As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Language: fluency in English and French/German Qualifications Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities. jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
jobs.jd: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing regional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that accelerates enterprise customer adoption by turning high-impact automation use cases into production-ready workflows. You'll own technical delivery quality, team development, and regional execution, while staying hands-on and empowering customers to become independent, successful builders. To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas: Build & Lead a High-Performing FDE Team Hire, onboard, and coach Forward Deployed Engineers across your region, partnering closely with Deployment Strategists to deliver high-impact customer engagements. Set and maintain a high technical quality bar for production workflows, custom nodes, integration architectures, and customer-facing delivery. Manage regional team capacity, workload, and staffing while staying hands-on with customer engagements and supporting your team's technical development. Own Regional Delivery & Customer Outcomes Lead regional engagement intake and prioritization with Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships, focusing resources on high-value accounts, strategic adoption opportunities, and at-risk renewals. Qualify and scope customer engagements, selecting the right mix of internal FDEs and delivery partners while ensuring clear success criteria, technical ownership, and timelines. Drive measurable customer outcomes through production-ready workflows, increased adoption, and seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers, while reporting regional results and expansion signals to leadership. Enable Customers & Scale Technical Excellence Champion a customer-first delivery approach where customers build alongside FDEs, develop technical confidence, and become capable of maintaining and scaling their own automations. Create and continuously improve reusable technical assets, including workflow templates, reference architectures, workshop materials, and hackathon playbooks. Capture learnings from customer engagements and turn them into scalable best practices that improve delivery quality and consistency across the global FDE team. jobs.title: Applied Scientist
jobs.jd: About Quilter At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: Curiosity Conviction Rigor Quilter is looking for Senior to Staff Applied Scientists and Software Engineers to help invent the next generation of automated PCB design. You'll design, implement and test state-of-the-art algorithms for some of the hardest problems in computational geometry, optimization, high-performance computing and physics simulation. As a senior member of the team, you'll help shape the technical roadmap, mentor your peers and build the foundation for superhuman PCB design. You'll work on one or more parts of the system, such as core learning algorithms, differential geometry techniques, state-of-the-art optimization methods, CPU and GPU backend performance, and fast physics simulation. What You’ll Do Drive applied research toward the next breakthrough in PCB design. Architect, implement and test high-performance libraries in Python, C++, Mojo, TypeScript, etc. Lead by example: mentor engineers, give technical reviews and help raise the team's engineering practices. What We’re Looking For 3 to 10+ years of industry experience maintaining and extending large, high-performance codebases in collaborative environments. A strong academic background in applied mathematics, with deep expertise in one or more of: optimization, machine learning, computational geometry, graph theory, high-performance computing (HPC), meshing, numerical methods, physics simulation, or a related field. Proficiency in Python for prototyping and for integrating with ML systems. Strong leadership skills: ownership, hiring and mentoring, sound decision-making and clear communication. Experience with reinforcement learning, CAD/EDA tools or physics-based optimization. Contributions to open-source geometry, simulation or HPC projects. Knowledge of physics engines, finite element methods (FEM) or distributed computing. Please note : We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.
